F01M.fTerm:
LUBRICATING OF MACHINES OR ENGINES IN GENERAL; LUBRICATING INTERNAL-COMBUSTION ENGINES; CRANKCASE VENTILATING[2]

Note(s)

  • Attention is drawn to the Notes preceding class F01, especially as regards Note (3).[8]
  • Attention is drawn to the following places, which cover lubrication of specific machines or engines:
    F01B 31/10Steam engines
    F01C 21/04Rotary-piston or oscillating-piston machines or engines

    F04B 39/02Pumps for elastic fluids
    F04C 29/02Rotary-piston or oscillating-piston pumps for liquids
    F04D 29/04Non-positive-displacement pumps
